title: Revenue bonds for onchain businesses
sentences: Bondrail lets onchain businesses issue revenue bonds to raise capital.
Investors fund the bonds, and a capped share of business revenue goes toward repayment.

title: A history investors can inspect
sentences: PumpLab's account records revenue before it raises.
Here, Slice excludes payments linked to issuer funding.
Envio turns those events into a payer history.
The credit estimate discounts short history and concentration.
These are controlled test wallets, not customer traction.

title: Capital released in stages
sentences: PumpLab uses a reviewed Native template that routes fees through its account.
Investors funded twenty USDC.
Ten was released; the rest stays in escrow until revenue and timing conditions are met.
The repayment cap scales with released capital.

title: One payment. Automatic repayment.
sentences: Now a test wallet makes a real PumpLab trade.
Twenty-five percent of its fee goes to the bond inside that transaction.
Repaid and backing per claim increase.
This Monad receipt shows the transfer to the bond.
Native repayment needs no separate collection transaction.

title: Trade the revenue claim
sentences: An investor can also buy claims on Kuru.
This quote comes from simulating the order against the live market.
The automated demo wallet signs, and its claim balance updates.
Market price reflects future revenue expectations; cash backing is only the amount collected so far.

title: Join an open raise
sentences: CurveLab is an open raise on the same template.
The demo wallet deposits one test USDC and receives claims.
Deposits are withdrawable while funding remains open.
If funding expires, cancellation enables investors to claim refunds.

title: HTTP revenue, watched onchain
sentences: HTTP payments use the Watched tier.
CRE simulation checks payment offers and broadcasts real reports to Monad.
Here is the latest compliant report and its transaction.
Checks run every thirty minutes; two adjacent violation reports trigger default and stake slashing.
